baselineReuseNote: Reuses frozen before artifacts from round 21, byte-identical to the verified production runtime. All source fingerprints are rechecked against the clean baseline commit before any candidate edit; prior documentation-only commits do not change the compiled runtime.

preflight.scope: Read-only process-name snapshot. It detects listed drivers at observation time only, not all workloads or sustained idleness. No process is stopped or changed; no paths, host identity or hardware details are recorded.

postflight.scope: Read-only process-name snapshot. It detects listed drivers at observation time only, not all workloads or sustained idleness. No process is stopped or changed; no paths, host identity or hardware details are recorded.

timingConditions.scope: Snapshots bracket all latency runs; they do not prove sustained host idleness. All raw runs are retained even if the postflight detects activity.

baselineSourceSnapshotRevalidation.proof: Baseline was freshly frozen from the committed renderer after prior test-only additions had been independently rebuilt byte-identical. No test-only exceptions are needed in either current shipping source snapshot.

method: Original extended Rust bench.rs driver: 5 warm-ups, >=10ms calibration, >=9 samples and >=300ms per operation per run. Three independent processes per version, alternating order. Every verification record must match across all six runs.
interpretation: Every process and regression retained. Small changes are not statistical-significance claims. Pre/post snapshots found no listed build/test driver; snapshots do not prove sustained host idleness. Builds, tests, CPU captures, allocator probes and process resource checks are separate from latency.

primaryAllocationProbe.scope: Separate counted allocator using the existing unchanged tools/profiler/src/allocator.rs; exact 167 original primary inputs and Arial16/CSS/fixed-clock options. Five complete warm-up batches and one counted batch per process; input/options setup excluded, full parsing/layout/SVG/results dropped each iteration. Requested bytes count full realloc requests and are not RSS. No overlap with latency.

candidateState: Measured local tokenizer scratch-state experiment; runtime not retained
decision: Do not retain this variant after considering all full-type time, allocation, code-size and actual RSS results. Exact source/test patch and every trial/regression preserved; published production results remain unchanged.
